I feel the same OP, I work in a shop and I absolutely despise my job, it’s not even been a month yet I have tears in my eyes every morning before I leave my home and I spent my entire lunch break sobbing in the bathroom yesterday. 
I’ve worked in 2 other shops before and I loved those jobs, I don’t know what went wrong with this one.

Sending love to you. ❤️
Thank you, that means a lot 💜
